skill_name: Develop an argument supporting a point.
workflow: Physical Education (PE) in schools is of paramount importance. Schools that offer PE classes give students the opportunity to be active and stay fit, thus reducing the risk of long-term illnesses such as heart disease, diabetes and obesity. It is also a great way for students to learn about their own physical capabilities, develop confidence and gain team building skills.
